provenance: Owner-reviewed fine candidates from built-in OpenAI image generation. Original exact generation prompts are unavailable; the prompt below is a reconstructed acceptance brief, not a verbatim generation transcript.
prompt: Repaint each existing shipped Ba Dan design with fine painted detail at the characters grain, about one screen pixel at default zoom. Preserve design, warm upper-left lighting, silhouette, registration and materials. Use soft dark-brown outlines one to two source pixels wide, painted ramps and no visible square texels; nothing blurrier than the characters. Carry dark-brown contact shading and slight lowest-stone-course darkening in the source.
preparation: Retained masters only: dwelling and village-tree are borrowed by Forest Road; the four native trees are the village's. The village's houses, stalls, planters and bridge are the true pieces (art/source/ba-dan-true/). The scripts that prepared the replaced masters were removed with them.

dwelling.source: untracked candidate (the hash below pins it)
dwelling.repair: Lit repaint on the old master's canvas and alpha (painter's notes: variety-prompts.md). It is the Forest Road lodge and is no longer used by the village, which draws the true pieces. It was put on the map's 2:1 projection by an affine resample (Lanczos-3, premultiplied colour, binary alpha) from a pre-correction master that is no longer tracked; the measurement below pins the result.

village-tree.repair: Integer vertical shift 0 px; local silhouette edge extensions up to 3 px; no whole-image scaling. Brown root tips extend toward the exact foot row and topmost foliage extends by two pixels.

Chroma averaged over each 2x2 block (chroma-fit.py) so the 4:2:0 encode holds the mean-error contract; luma and alpha untouched.

varietyPrepared: 2026-10-07: village-tree is the old master, kept for the forest alder (its lit repaint was rejected: jet-black underside matte); three native trees and the 150x165 sapling were added.

projection.target: Every ground line on the map runs at slope +0.5 (along grid x) or -0.5 (along grid y): 26.565 degrees.
projection.method: The lodge master is measured on its lower silhouette (scripts/art/lib/ba-dan-projection.ts: Theil-Sen over the windows in "measure") for its left slope mL (running down to the right) and right slope mR; it was conformed with x' = a*x, y' = y + k*x, a = mL - mR, k = -(mL + mR)/2, which sends them onto +0.5 and -0.5. "placed" records where the pre pixels went. The shipped dwelling.webp is guarded by ba-dan-projection.test.ts.
